verdicts.reason: Both use the same sensible left-headline, right-cat banner split, but in both the cat cluster ends about 20px above the bottom edge, so it floats instead of bleeding off the canvas as in the original, and the cats feel small next to the large empty purple areas. A breaks the headline as 'KEEP / CALM AND / GET A CAT', leaving a weak orphaned 'KEEP' on top. B's 'KEEP CALM / AND / GET A CAT' follows the classic slogan rhythm, but its short middle line makes the left edge of the text block look ragged.
